entries.title: File browser
entries.text: Browse the guest’s internal storage, and import or export files and folders.

entries.title: More memory
entries.text: On devices that allow it, the guest’s RAM can now go above 4 GiB.

entries.title: Stability fixes
points: Fixed the guest crashing on many iPhones
Fixed a crash when returning to Andarium from the background
Fixed crashes in some 3D games and apps
Fixed a crash when using the gyroscope
Fixed high CPU use and heat after a network connection drops
